title: InboundEventEnvelope
description: Envelope for every inbound operational event, per AEROOPS_SYSTEM_DESIGN.md section 5. Wraps a typed payload (see flight-event.schema.json) with identity, tenancy and timing metadata needed for idempotent, auditable ingestion.

event_id.description: Unique identifier assigned by the source system. Used with source_system as the dedupe key.

tenant_id.description: Airport tenant this event belongs to. Resolved from the authenticated integration credential, never trusted from payload alone.

source.description: Identifier of the originating system, e.g. AODB, HANDLER, SIMULATOR.

event_type.description: Discriminator for payload shape, e.g. flight.update, stand.assignment, task.update.

schema_version.description: Version of the payload schema this event was produced against.

occurred_at.description: UTC timestamp when the event occurred at the source.

received_at.description: UTC timestamp when AeroOps received the event.

correlation_id.description: Optional identifier linking related events across a single operational transaction.

payload.description: Event-type-specific body. See flight-event.schema.json for event_type=flight.update.
